title: Timelapse: one short console note every 50 layers (instead of a line for every layer)
note: Fluidd's console shows an echo of a command the Moonraker timelapse component sends after every frame (SET_GCODE_VARIABLE ... takingframe VALUE=False): one line per layer, with no information in it. Hide that line with a console filter in Fluidd (it is a display setting only) and use this module so you still see that the timelapse is running: 'Timelapse is on: layer N/total' at layer 1 and then every 50 layers. The note is shown only when the timelapse is enabled for the print. It says the timelapse is on, not that every frame was saved; a failed frame capture is handled by timelapse-capture-recovery.
